source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The follow-up adds negative and upper-bound row checks to IsContainer, IsContainerOpen, GetParentIndex, HasNextSibling, GetLevel, ToggleOpenState and GetCellProperties. Invalid rows return NS_ERROR_INVALID_ARG before mRowMap access; ToggleOpenState also returns before mutation. This broadens the earlier name-column-only fix. The accepted class no longer implements nsITreeView, so these guards describe the historical interface rather than the current subscription UI.
title: Seven historical subscription tree callbacks reject invalid rows before lookup
